manifest.name: dsh-power-button
manifest.description: Self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward 重启/关机 menu plus a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), MIT licensed.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# dsh-power-button bundle patch: mount into the profile.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-power-button
      name: 'dsh-power-button'

readme.text:
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A self-contained **power & lifecycle controller** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness): a sidebar power button with a Restart / Shutdown menu and a full-screen transition overlay. The restart engine is built in — no third-party dependencies.

> Developed with DeepSeek AI assistance; reviewed before release.

- **Sidebar power button** in the footer action slot, theme-aware and styled to match the adjacent Settings trigger.
- **Restart / Shutdown menu** with a Windows-style full-screen overlay; the page reloads by itself after a confirmed restart.
- **Self-contained restart engine**: a detached `.cjs` helper takes over relaunching DSH through an ARM → COMMIT → ACK handshake, waits for the old process, the port and the session logs, then relaunches the same invocation in the same cwd. A `--port 0` command line is pinned to the port the old process actually bound. In the Desktop app the restart is handed to Electron instead, when that app advertises a restart protocol. No PowerShell, no `taskkill`.
- **`/restart` and `/shutdown` commands**, a **`restart_harness` model tool** (registration is skipped when another plugin already owns the name), and a read-only **`restart_status`** tool for checking whether a restart happened.
- **Localized UI and host notices** (zh / en), following the profile's `locale.preference`.
- **Startup housekeeping**: helper logs and scripts, per-restart handshake records, and undelivered notices older than 7 days are pruned from the runtime directory.

**① Sidebar power button** — theme-aware footer entry.

**② Restart / Shutdown menu** — two actions, one click away.

**③ Shutdown confirm dialog** — the default focus sits on **Cancel**; only an explicit confirm stops the process.

**④ Shutdown progress overlay** — shows the current stage while the process winds down.

**⑤ Restart completed toast** — after the auto reload, a notice confirms DSH is back.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button#master"
```

Restart DSH; a power button appears in the sidebar footer. Requires Node ≥ 22.19.
Configured through the profile's cordis layer (`cordis.patch.yml` or the settings UI):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enableModelTool` | `true` | Register the `restart_harness` model tool. Set `false` to keep restart on the GUI button and `/restart` only. |
| `maxDelayMs` | `5000` | Upper bound (ms) for the model tool's `delayMs`. The effective floor is 1000 ms. |
| `restartWakeMode` | `quiet` | What the session that asked for a restart is told afterwards. `quiet` stages the notice for its next step without waking anything; `notify` also wakes that session once it is live, so the model reports the restart without a user message. Neither mode restarts anything on its own. |

```yaml
- id: dsh-power-button
  config:
    enableModelTool: true
```

Restart is an explicit ARM → COMMIT → ACK handshake. The old process does not exit until a live helper owns the relaunch; every failure before the ACK keeps the old process running. After spawning the successor, the helper waits up to 180 seconds for readiness. The browser allows a five-minute polling budget for the full restart, including shutdown and preparation. A refused request remains an error even if later health probes fail.

```
click power → Restart
[host]    POST /api/dsh-power-button/restart
          write the per-restart helper .cjs (0600: it embeds the relaunch argv)
          spawn `node <helper>` detached

Five invariants hold this together:

- The helper lives **outside the process tree** (`detached`, a real `.cjs` file — a multi-line `node -e` is mangled by Windows `CreateProcess`), so terminating DSH cannot kill it mid-flight.
- Success is confirmed by a per-process `instanceId` that must **change**, so a brief outage never fakes it.
- The launcher's exit channel is read at `ctx.get('appExit')`, never as a property: it is an optional host service this plugin does not inject, and a property read resolves to `undefined` — which would skip graceful disposal and hard-kill instead.
- Exit is bounded end to end, and the bounds are **derived rather than duplicated**: graceful exit gets a 15 s watchdog, the pre-exit flush cap is 5 s, and the helper's patience for the old PID is computed from both, so they cannot drift into the helper giving up first.
- The successor's environment is **re-read from the registry**, not inherited: a process environment is a snapshot from its launcher, so a variable changed with `setx` or System Properties would otherwise never reach the relaunched instance. The block is composed in the order Windows uses — the inherited block as the base layer, machine values over it, then user values shadowing
Shutdown posts `/api/dsh-power-button/shutdown` and stops without relaunching. It is irreversible, so the button and `/shutdown` both open a confirm dialog; the model is never given shutdown.

The Desktop application runs the Host as a child of its Electron shell, so exiting that child invokes the app's crash recovery and replaying its command line yields a Host without a window or its original IPC channel. Two cases, decided by what the host advertises:

- **Host advertises a restart protocol** (`DSH_DESKTOP_RESTART_PROTOCOL` in the Host environment, IPC channel connected): the plugin writes the restart marker, flushes live sessions, and asks the shell to restart; Electron owns the relaunch. If the shell does not take over within 20 seconds, the request fails, the transition is released, and the button works again.
- **Host advertises nothing** (every released DeepSeek Harness so far): restart and shutdown are refused with `503` and `reason: "desktop-unsupported"`; no helper or exit is scheduled. Use the application's Quit menu or tray action, then reopen it — closing the main window can leave the app running in the tray.

Making the first case available means changing DeepSeek Harness itself, which is outside this plugin's boundary; the steps are in [`docs/desktop-restart-protocol.md`](docs/desktop-restart-protocol.md).

- Destructive POSTs go through **the deployment's own browser-trust fence and authentication** via `ctx.connection.requestRejection` — the call the host's `/api` route uses. `/api/dsh-power-button/*` is longer than the official `/api` prefix, so longest-prefix matching never routes these requests through that fence; delegating keeps them under the operator's real policy, including LAN authorities derived from an all-interface bind and any `trustedHosts` / `--trusted-host` declaration.
- On a host with no connection service (a profile without the web bundle) the plugin falls back to its own rules: `Host` must be a loopback authority or one the host declared, plus the cross-site and full-authority `Origin` checks. That fallback is narrower than the official fence and can only refuse; it does **not** provide browser-session authentication.
- A refusal answers with a stable `reason` code and logs the observed `Host` / `Origin` / `sec-fetch-site` / remote address. `host-fence` and `not-authenticated` mean the deployment decided, not this plugin.
- An **at-most-once latch** rejects duplicate transitions, so a concurrent second POST gets `409`.
- The model tool's `delayMs` is **floored at

- **The UI** shows a localized "Restarted" toast. The restart identity stays on `/health` for the process's whole life; acknowledging the toast clears only the pending flag.
- **The session that asked** gets a notice shaped by `restartWakeMode` — `Agent.inject()` when `quiet`, `Agent.followup()` when `notify`. Only a restart with a recorded causal session gets one: a GUI click records none and is never attributed to whichever conversation happens to be open. At most one notice per session is queued and it is deleted once delivered.
- **Every other session** can call `restart_status`, which reports whether a restart happened, its id, stage, the instances involved, timings, who asked, and whether the running process is the instance that restart produced.

The plugin never appends a model-visible event and never forges a turn: awareness is handed to the Agent API, whose `inject()` durably stages an `agent/inbox/spliced` record for the next legitimate step. Delivery is once per notice in normal operation; a crash between the inbox write and the deletion can repeat it, and the notice text is written so a repeat is harmless.

`/health` also reports `appExit: "available" | "missing"` — whether the launcher-provided exit channel actually resolves here, which turns a delayed restart into a one-request diagnosis. Both exit paths log the pre-exit flush tally (`live` / `fulfilled` / `rejected` / `timedOut`), so a refused or partial durable write is visible afterwards instead of looking like a clean exit.

```sh
pnpm build            # tsdown: host + client bundle (committed to lib/)
pnpm typecheck        # tsc --noEmit over src
pnpm typecheck:tests  # the root tsconfig excludes tests/
pnpm test             # vitest: unit + process-level acceptance

CI runs both typechecks, tests and build on Windows, Ubuntu and macOS, gates that the committed `lib/` matches a fresh build byte for byte, and checks the `pnpm pack` tarball; a separate Linux job repeats everything on Node **22.19**, the floor `engines.node` declares. `tests/restart-runtime.spec.ts` runs the exact helper the host generates as a real process against real TCP ports - the relaunch chain, no relaunch without COMMIT, bounded spawn retries, a stale instance refused, and the failure diagnoses - and the suite isolates `DSH_HOME`, so it never touches your real `~/.dsh`.

MIT. The "detached helper relaunch" idea follows [anweat/dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart) (MIT); the implementation is independently written (real `.cjs` file, no PowerShell, dynamic port), no code copied.

Thanks to [@qq1131909103](https://github.com/qq1131909103): PR #8 established that the Desktop Host belongs to the Electron shell, which is why this plugin refuses power actions there instead of spawning a competing Host, and what `docs/desktop-restart-protocol.md` is built on.

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) 的自包含**电源与生命周期控制**插件：侧边栏底部**电源按钮** + 上拉**重启/关机**菜单 + 全屏过渡动画。重启引擎内置在本插件中，**不依赖第三方插件**。

> 由 DeepSeek AI 辅助开发，发布前经人工 review。

- **侧边栏电源按钮**：注册到页脚操作位（`sidebar.footer.action`），主题自适应，外观与旁边的"设置"按钮一致
- **重启/关机菜单** + Windows 关机风格全屏过渡；重启确认后页面自动刷新
- **自包含重启引擎**：写一个 detached 的 `.cjs` helper，经 ARM → COMMIT → ACK 握手接手拉起职责，等旧进程、端口与会话日志都落定后，以相同调用方式与原目录重新拉起 DSH；`--port 0` 命令行会被固定为本进程实际绑定的端口。桌面版若宿主广播了重启协议，则改为交给 Electron 外壳重启。不使用 PowerShell、不使用 `taskkill`
- **`/restart` 与 `/shutdown` 命令**、**`restart_harness` 模型工具**（名字已被其它插件占用时跳过注册），以及只读的 **`restart_status`** 诊断工具
- **界面与宿主文案本地化**（中文 / English），跟随 profile 的 `locale.preference`
- **启动清理**：自动清理运行目录下超过 7 天的 helper 日志与脚本、每次重启的握手记录，以及尚未投递的通知

**① 侧边栏电源按钮** —— 主题适配的底部常驻入口。

**② 重启 / 关机菜单** —— 两个动作一次到位。

**③ 关机确认对话框** —— 默认焦点在「取消」，只有显式确认才会停止进程。

**④ 关机进度遮罩** —— 进程收尾时显示当前阶段。

**⑤ 重启完成提示** —— 页面自动重载后确认 DSH 已恢复。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button#master"
```

重启 DSH 后生效：侧边栏底部出现电源按钮。需要 Node ≥ 22.19。

通过 profile 的 cordis 层配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 或设置界面）：

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enableModelTool` | `true` | 注册 `restart_harness` 模型工具。设 `false` 则重启仅保留在 GUI 按钮与 `/restart`。 |
| `maxDelayMs` | `5000` | 模型工具 `delayMs` 参数的上限（ms）。有效下限为 1000 ms。 |
| `restartWakeMode` | `quiet` | 重启后如何告知**发起它的那个会话**。`quiet` 只把通知暂存给它的下一个 step，不唤醒任何东西；`notify` 额外在该会话变成 live 后唤醒它，模型无需用户发消息即可报告结果。两种模式都不会自行再次重启。 |

```yaml
- id: dsh-power-button
  config:
    enableModelTool: true
```

重启是显式 ARM → COMMIT → ACK 握手：只有活着的 helper 确认接手拉起职责，旧进程才会退出；ACK 之前的任何失败都会保留旧进程。拉起新实例后，helper 最多等待 180 秒确认就绪。浏览器为包含退出与准备阶段的完整重启提供五分钟的轮询预算。请求被拒绝后，即使后续健康探测失败，界面也会保留错误状态。

```
点击电源 → 重启
[宿主]   POST /api/dsh-power-button/restart
         写出本次重启专用的 helper .cjs（0600：内嵌拉起 argv）
         spawn `node <helper>` detached

五条不变量支撑这套流程：

- helper 必须**脱离进程树**（`detached` + 真实 `.cjs` 文件——多行 `node -e` 会被 Windows `CreateProcess` 破坏），否则终止 DSH 时 helper 一起被杀
- 重启成功以**每次进程独立的 `instanceId` 变化**为准，短暂离线本身不算成功
- 启动器的退出通道在 `ctx.get('appExit')` 读取，**不能当属性读**：它是本插件未在 `inject` 中声明的可选宿主服务，按属性读会得到 `undefined`，从而跳过优雅销毁、直接硬杀
- 退出全链有界，且**边界是推导出来的而非各写一份**：优雅退出 15 秒看门狗、退出前 flush 上限 5 秒，helper 等旧 PID 的耐心由两者计算而来，避免日后漂移成"helper 先放弃"
- 新进程的环境**从注册表重新读取**，而不是继承：进程环境是启动器创建时的快照，否则用 `setx` 或系统属性改过的变量永远到不了重启后的实例。环境块按 Windows 的顺序组合——以继承块为**底层**，系统值覆盖其上，用户值再覆盖系统值——`REG_EXPAND_SZ` 只对它自己那一阶段可见的变量展开，因此系统值看不到仅用户存在的名字。这种隔离是**注册表层之间**的隔离，不是逐字节复现 Windows 构建环境块的过程：启动器原有进程块里的名字在每一阶段都可见——这是刻意的，因为其中有些（本机上的 `SystemRoot`）只存在于进程环境里。`PATH` 保留两半（系统在前），每段按各自类型展开后再去重。读取走 `reg export`（UTF-16LE），非 ASCII 值在任何控制台代码页下都能保真；导出文件是 harness home 下的临时文件，同一次调用内删除，它继承该目录的 ACL——和 `.credentials.yaml` 完全一样，**在 Windows 上文件模式并不构成隐私保证**。从注册表**删除**的变量仍然看不到；从注册表 `PATH` 里删掉、但启动器进程块里仍有的目录也会保留——它和"包管理器在启动时注入的目录"无法区分，丢掉后者会让按名字解析工具的子进程直接失败。非 Windows 平台保持纯继承
关机 POST `/api/dsh-power-button/shutdown`，终止且不拉起。由于不可逆，电源按钮和 `/shutdown` 都会先弹确认对话框；模型不暴露关机。

桌面应用中 Host 是 Electron 外壳的子进程：退出这个子进程会触发应用的崩溃恢复，重放它的命令行则会得到没有窗口、也没有原 IPC 通道的 Host。按宿主是否广播能力分两种情况：

- **宿主广播了重启协议**（Host 环境里有 `DSH_DESKTOP_RESTART_PROTOCOL`，且 IPC 通道已连接）：插件写入重启标记、刷盘在跑的会话，然后请外壳重启，由 Electron 接管拉起。若外壳 20 秒内没有接手，请求按失败返回、操作锁释放，按钮可再次使用。
- **宿主没有任何广播**（目前所有已发布的 DeepSeek Harness）：重启与关机都被拒绝，返回 `503` 与 `reason: "desktop-unsupported"`，不会派生 helper、也不会安排退出。请用应用菜单或托盘的退出，然后重新打开；只关主窗口可能让应用继续留在托盘里。
要让第一种情况可用，必须修改 DeepSeek Harness 本身，这超出本插件的边界；步骤写在 [`docs/desktop-restart-protocol.zh-CN.md`](docs/desktop-restart-protocol.zh-CN.md)。

- 破坏性 POST 由**本部署自己的浏览器信任栅栏与认证**保护：通过 `ctx.connection.requestRejection` 取自宿主，与宿主 `/api` 路由用的是同一个调用。`/api/dsh-power-button/*` 比官方 `/api` 前缀更长，最长前缀匹配**不会**把这些请求交给那道栅栏；委托给它，才能让端点始终处于运维者真实策略之下——包括 Web 运行时从"绑定所有网卡"推导出的 LAN 权威，以及任何 `trustedHosts` / `--trusted-host` 声明
- 宿主没有 connection 服务时（例如不含 web bundle 的 profile），插件退回自己那份规则副本：`Host` 必须是 loopback 权威或宿主声明过的权威，外加跨站与完整 authority 的 `Origin` 校验。该副本比官方更窄、只会拒绝，但它**不提供浏览器会话认证**
- 被拒时返回稳定的 `reason` 码，并把观测到的 `Host`/`Origin`/`sec-fetch-site`/remote 地址写进日志。`host-fence` 与 `not-authenticated` 表示是**部署自己的规则**判的，不是插件
- **at-most-once 锁**：并发重复触发会被拒绝（第二次返回 `409`）
- 模型工具 `delayMs` **下限 1000 ms**——模型无法在自身 turn 结束前杀掉进程
- 重启 marker 在启动时**消费即删除**，后续普通启动不会误报；命令行日志**脱敏**，helper 与 marker 以 `0600` 写入，运行目录 `0700`

readme.section: 重启后，会话能知道什么
readme.text:
三件独立的事，刻意不合并：

- **界面**弹出本地化 toast。进程整个生命周期都通过 `/health` 的 `restart.fromInstanceId`、`restart.restartId` 暴露重启身份；确认 toast 只清 pending 标志，不会抹掉身份
- **发起重启的那个会话**收到通知，形态由 `restartWakeMode` 决定：`quiet` 用 `Agent.inject()`，`notify` 用 `Agent.followup()`。只有记录了 causal session 的重启才会发；GUI 点击不记录会话，也就不会归到恰好打开着的那个会话上。每个会话最多排队一条，投递后即删除
- **其他会话**可调用 `restart_status`，获取是否发生过重启、restartId、阶段、被替换与新实例、各阶段时间、发起者，以及当前进程是否就是该次重启的产物

readme.section: 重启后，会话能知道什么
readme.text:
本插件**从不自己追加模型可见的消息、不伪造 turn**：通知交给 Agent API，`inject()` 会持久登记一条 `agent/inbox/spliced` 记录交给下一个合法 step 认领。正常运行时每条通知只投递一次；若在 inbox 写入与删除之间崩溃则可能重复，通知文案已写成重放无害。

`/health` 另外报告 `appExit: "available" | "missing"`——本宿主里启动器的退出通道是否真的可用，把"重启偏慢"变成一次请求就能定位的问题。两条退出路径都会记录退出前 flush 的计数（`live`/`fulfilled`/`rejected`/`timedOut`），使被拒或部分失败不再是"看起来像干净退出"。

```sh
pnpm build            # tsdown：宿主 + 客户端 bundle（提交到 lib/）
pnpm typecheck        # tsc --noEmit 检查 src
pnpm typecheck:tests  # 根 tsconfig 不包含 tests/
pnpm test             # vitest：单元 + 进程级验收

CI 在 Windows / Ubuntu / macOS 上跑两套类型检查、测试与构建，并校验提交的 `lib/` 与重新构建结果逐字节一致、`pnpm pack` 产物含 `lib/` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`；另有独立 Linux job 在 **Node 22.19**（`engines.node` 声明的下限）重跑全部步骤。`tests/restart-runtime.spec.ts` 把宿主生成的那一份真实 helper 当独立进程对着真实 TCP 端口跑：完整拉起链、没有 COMMIT 就不拉起、spawn 重试上限、拒绝旧实例、以及各类失败诊断；测试经 vitest setup 隔离 `DSH_HOME`，不会碰你真实的 `~/.dsh`。

MIT。"detached helper 拉起"的思路参考 [anweat/dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart)（MIT）；实现为独立编写（真实 `.cjs` 文件、不使用 PowerShell、动态端口），未复制其代码。

感谢 [@qq1131909103](https://github.com/qq1131909103)：PR #8 指出桌面端 Host 归 Electron 外壳所有。本插件在桌面端拒绝电源操作、而不是另起一个竞争 Host，以及 `docs/desktop-restart-protocol.md` 的出发点，都来自这个判断。
